description: The intended contribution: between-vs-within subject distance ratio on effective weight deltas DeltaW = (alpha/r) * B . A per adapted layer, before and after Euclidean Alignment. Consumes checkpoints saved by run_experiment.py (checkpoints/ dir). Requires multi-seed runs per subject so within-subject spread (same subject, different seeds) can be computed as the noise floor. See delta_w_diagnostics.py and run_diagnostic.sh.

metric.within_spread: mean distance from each seed's DeltaW to its subject centroid (noise floor)
metric.between_spread: mean pairwise distance between subject centroids (signal)
metric.ratio: between / within; ~1 => centroid fine, >>1 => centroid structurally wrong

runs_needed.pre_ea: reptile_lora or baseline_lora, all 9 subjects, 5 seeds, no --ea
